jobs.title: Senior Manager, Applications Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding American industrial capability for a new era of autonomy, robotics, and electrification.

We are the only U.S. company with a fully integrated rare earth supply chain—from mining and refining to advanced metal and magnet manufacturing. Our products include both the critical materials used to make permanent magnets and the finished magnets themselves—enabling next-generation technologies in robotics, automation, aerospace, transportation, defense, and energy systems. These materials are the foundation of physical AI—the convergence of computation, movement, and control.

We hire ambitious, mission-driven people who want to tackle complex challenges and shape the future of strategic industries. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, resiliency, and integrity, with a deep commitment to operational excellence and national purpose. MP is rapidly evolving from a materials producer into a leading U.S. manufacturer—and our people are driving that transformation.

Position Overview:

The Senior Manager of Applications Engineering will be a leader by example, action-oriented, willing to get their hands dirty, and have experience leading technical teams. The successful candidate will play a critical role in identifying current and future product value by synthesizing customer needs, market trends, representing the voice of the customer within the broader technical team. They will use their deep understanding of relevant manufacturing processes to recommend and design NdFeB magnets that can be produced safely, efficiently, and repeatably. The successful candidate for this role will understand how customers use the unique properties of rare earth permanent magnets across a variety of end use applications, as well as the broad range of chemical, mechanical, and thermal processes used to produce magnets, magnet assemblies, and electric motors, and will be experienced at working with customers in design and quoting processes.

Position Responsibilities:

Lead the team that acts as the primary technical contact with existing and potential customers in designing, prototyping, and transitioning products into manufacturing.
Manage the technical interface between customers and cross-functional MP Materials teams that design and manufacture rare earth magnets.
Act as the hands-on leader of a team of engineers and technicians, using excellent communication and organizational skills to direct their activities.
Develop tools and methods to succinctly summarize and communicate project status.
Control budget and timing of internal and customer-facing applications development projects.
Organize and adjust both short and long duration team goals based on current business conditions and evolving customer and market needs.
Identify value opportunities for MP Materials products, to be realized through applications engineering, product or process development, continuous improvement activities, or long-term strategic initiatives.
Work closely with EHS to ensure that all work is done to ensure world class health and safety, and full compliance with relevant environmental regulations.
Other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

BS or higher in Materials, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or other relevant disciplines.
Working knowledge of rare earth magnets and/or permanent magnet motors, actuators, and sensors including end use applications and key performance metrics.
Experience working directly with external customers to understand technical needs and translate them into operational actions.
At least 5 years of experience managing a technical team.
Experience partnering with commercial teams to generate product specifications and quotations.
Understanding of the cost, yield and quality of manufactured product(s).
Experience with material manufacturing, particularly NdFeB magnet manufacturing.
Ability to effectively communicate with a spectrum of different roles, from customers to senior leaders to manufacturing operators.
Ability to lead teams solving customer problems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare well-written documents for reporting to customers and senior leadership.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent projects.

Desired Qualities:

In-depth knowledge of design of electric devices and/or magnets for electric devices.
Knowledge of rare earth permanent magnet grades and magnetic properties of those grades.
Understanding the manufacturing processes for rare earth materials and permanent magnets.
Advanced degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Materials Science Engineering.
Expert level user of Microsoft Office suite.

Influence across organizational boundaries to align teams around shared platforms and standards.

10+ years of experience in enterprise application development and architecture, with 5+ years in architecture leadership roles.
Proven experience leading member‑facing digital platforms at scale.
Deep expertise in cloud‑native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure), APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.

Job Description

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering
leads a high impact pillar within the Legal & Privacy engineering organization, responsible for engineering the systems, platforms, and controls that enable the company to operate in compliance with global regulatory requirements and pro-actively managing enterprise risk. This leader is responsible for translating complex regulatory obligations into scalable, resilient, and engineering solutions enabling NBCUniversal.

This role requires both deep technical and senior leadership with business acumen in the compliance and risk space. This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of compliance and risk technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Legal, Cyber, and Compliance/Risk Product and Operations. This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the compliance and risk engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Engineering Leadership & Delivery
Leads a team of software and quality engineers delivering compliance automation, AI solutions, risk controls, and regulatory technology platforms
Owns the engineering roadmap for the compliance and risk pillar while balancing regulatory urgency, technical sustainability, and product prioritization
Establish and uphold software quality, legal & privacy architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility

Compliance and Regulatory
Translate regulatory requirements (eg. GDPR and CCPA) into technical a deliverable plan
Oversee platforms, automation, and AI solutions enabling the following business capabilities: Ethics & Compliance Enablement, Controls Engineering & Validation, Compliance Driven Vulnerability Discovery, Regulatory Compliance Automation, Risk Management Tooling, GRC Platform Operations, AI / ML Governance and Controls

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
Serve as the senior technical voice for compliance and risk engineering
Communicate program status, risk exposure, and engineering trade-offs to SVPs, VPs and Directors in a clear and business relevant terms
Represent the organization in regulatory discussions, 3rd party audits, and external partner engagements as needed

System Reliability & Performance:
Proactively manage reliability and performance of all Compliance and Risks systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance.
Defect & Enhancement Management:
Manage the defect management process from identification to resolution. Manage the delivery of enhancements that improve user experience and system efficiency.
Problem & Incident Management:
Own the problem management process, conducting root cause analysis to reduce the number of recurring incidents. Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues. Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Compliance and Risk business processes. Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications. Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.
Support Standards & SLAs:
Enforce global support standards and best practices including adherence to SLAs for all support activities. Monitor and report on performance metrics (e.g. MTTR, backlog aging) and use data to drive continuous improvements.
Data Integration:
Manage the support and maintenance of data integrations between Compliance & Risk applications and other enterprise systems, leveraging middleware technologies.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in software engineering with 4+ years in engineering management or senior technical leadership
5+ years of experience leading ML and automation solutions
3+ years of experience in deploying AI solutions
Demonstrated experience delivering compliance, regulatory, risk, or governance technology in a large enterprise environment
Working knowledge of major privacy and compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA)
Strong track record of leading cross-functional programs with legal, privacy, and compliance stakeholders
Proven ability to influence and communicate at S/VP levels
Experience managing and growing engineering teams (software and quality engineers + managers) in a matrixed Fortune 100 or equivalent environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience with data governance platforms or GRC
Familiarity with AI/ML, emerging regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF)
Experience supporting regulatory privacy or security certification
Experience with ITSM tools (e.g. ServiceNow and Jira)

Fully Remote: 
This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Description

Help Shape the Future of Modern Mobility

Role Overview

This role sits at the center of Travelpro’s transformation—from a trusted legacy brand into a design-led, consumer-obsessed modern mobility company
.

The Head of Technology & Network Experience leads our technology function across the U.S. and Canada from our Boca Raton, FL headquarters. The role owns the Microsoft ecosystem, the Fortinet network and security stack, VPN and connectivity, JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, and the full software and subscription portfolio, and it implements and secures AI in partnership with the Head of Digital Transformation. In the first 6 to 12 months, success means a stable, well-secured environment, a maturing JD Edwards practice, and clear technology standards across both countries. The role partners closely with Operations, Finance, and Customer Service, manages our MSP partners, and works alongside our Canada-based JDE expert. It is a hands-on leadership role created to support the rapid growth of our U.S. operations

What You’ll Do

Serve as the hands-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne expert for the U.S. organization, owning system stability, integrations, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Own and administer the full Microsoft ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Windows endpoints) across all U.S. and Canadian sites.
Manage the Fortinet network and security stack (FortiGate firewalls and routers, switching, wireless, SD-WAN) and all VPN, remote access, and site-to-site connectivity.
Implement and secure AI across the business, owning the security, access, and governance posture company-wide, while the Head of Digital Transformation owns AI strategy and tool selection.
Own the full software and subscription portfolio and hold our MSP partners accountable for service quality, scope, and cost.
Lead cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and business continuity, and deliver network and technology training to raise everyday technology fluency.
Plan and optimize the IT budget across both countries, and act as a trusted technology advisor to senior leadership.
Provide leadership to our Canada-based Technology & Network Experience Lead, a deep JDE expert who reports into this role, building shared bench strength on the platform.

Requirements

What It Takes

8+ years in IT or infrastructure leadership, including multi-site responsibility and direct vendor or MSP management.
Hands-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne or SAP experience is required; this role must be, or rapidly become, an expert in the company’s ERP.
Experience in distribution, manufacturing, or consumer products is preferred.
Proven success managing MSP partners and outsourced or co-managed IT.
Practical experience implementing and securing AI tools in a business environment.
Team leadership, with the ability to lead change and align stakeholders across locations.

Capabilities

Strategic thinking paired with hands-on execution and a bias for results.
Strong communication and stakeholder alignment across executive, operational, and frontline audiences.
Analytical, data-informed decision-making.
Adaptability in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
Sound judgment and the discipline to bring order to evolving systems and priorities.

Why this role matters

Our U.S. operations have grown to roughly three times the size of Canada, and the technology function needs U.S.-based leadership to match.
Reliable, secure, well-run technology underpins our distribution, DTC, and customer service performance.
Strong JD Edwards stewardship protects the backbone the entire business runs on.
Disciplined AI implementation and security let us move quickly on AI without taking on undue risk.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field; MBA or equivalent a plus.
Expert-level JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, or a comparable Tier 1 ERP such as SAP (required).
Hands-on expertise across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Windows endpoint management.
Strong Fortinet and next-generation firewall, VPN, switching, wireless, and SD-WAN networking across multi-site environments.
Proficiency with Power BI or a comparable business intelligence platform.
Solid grounding in cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory compliance, and data privacy.
Certifications such as Fortinet NSE, Microsoft 365 Certified, or CompTIA Network+/Security+ preferred.

Working Environment

On-site at the Boca Raton, FL headquarters, with hands-on interaction with IT, network, and server-room equipment.
Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally (servers, network gear, laptops).
Flexible hours for after-hours maintenance windows and incident response.
Occasional travel to the Jackson, GA and Los Angeles distribution operations and the Canadian office.

What We Offer

A Culture Built for Growth:

We believe in collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. We move fast, support one another, and challenge ourselves to keep evolving.

Flexibility & Wellbeing

Flexible Time Away, company-paid holidays, and hybrid work flexibility.

Comprehensive Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts, and wellness programs.

Invest In Your Future

401(k) company match.

Community & Connection

Employee-led engagement initiatives focused on wellbeing, collaboration, and creating a workplace where everyone belongs.

About Travelpro®

Travelpro® was founded by airline pilot Bob Plath, whose firsthand travel experience inspired the invention of the original Rollaboard® suitcase — changing modern travel forever. Today, we are building on that legacy as we evolve into a modern mobility and travel lifestyle brand designed for today’s global traveler. Our products combine aviation-level performance with elevated design, helping ambitious people move confidently through every journey.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
to be primarily responsible for enabling Solutions Engineers (SEs) to maximize their potential in driving top line revenue in partnership with Sales in Carrier vertical. This First-Line Manager (1LM) position will be responsible for coaching the SEs reporting to them to best navigate their day-to-day responsibilities and ongoing trajectory within their role, requiring both a thorough tactical and thorough strategic understanding of the role and responsibilities of the SE, including technical expertise, business and customer expertise, and workflow and process expertise. Our Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
is expected to occasionally be a “player-coach” and dive into opportunity-oriented work while also bringing management-level engagement to deal-level and customer-level engagement, both internally and externally.

As a 1LM, the Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
will be responsible for driving a mentor-like relationship with each of their direct reports. As such, our Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
is expected to bring the utmost integrity to their day-to-day interactions internally and externally and is expected to handle confidential or sensitive matters within their purview with the utmost professionalism. Additionally, our Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
is expected to be focused on talent development, engagement and retention within their teams, and be an evangelist of the SE Organization within the broader Zayo community.

Reporting to the Head of Solutions Engineering, our Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
will be responsible for not only ensuring compliance with pre-defined metrics of SE team performance, both in aggregate and at the individual level, but also contributing regularly to the development of strategy, tools, and measurements that allow for overall organizational growth. Our Senior Manager of Solutions Engineering
will typically be tasked with strategic projects that further the broader mission and guiding principles of the SE Organization.

Responsibilities:

Leadership and Strategic Development

Lead a team of (typically five to ten) Solution Engineers within a defined scope, maximize the potential of direct reports relative to driving new revenue and otherwise fulfilling the mission and guiding principles of the SE Organization.
Serve as the primary mentor for direct reports across all elements of day-to-day and long-term role and responsibilities to maximize engagement and retention.
Serve as the primary point of technical and solutioning escalation for customers and internal stakeholders represented within the team.
Serve as a feedback loop between SEs and higher leadership levels to ensure organizational direction is clearly disseminated to the team and to ensure that directional feedback from SEs is adequately captured.
Manage the day-to-day responsibility queue of the SE team and drive activity to ensure fulsome completion of all needs in a manner that meets or exceeds SLA targets.

Sales Focus and Solution Design

Provide management-level technical consultation to customers and internal stakeholders to accelerate the sales cycle and drive opportunities from development to close.
Provide coaching to direct reports and others within the ecosystem to navigate complex solutioning scenarios.
Ensure fulsome communication between Sales and SE ecosystems to enable Sales priorities to be dynamically responded to by Solution Engineering.
Engage directly in solutioning on an as-needed basis.

Technical Expertise

Provide guidance to Sales and SEs on the most complex solutioning scenarios.
Keep abreast of competitive landscape and emerging technologies are essential to best position Zayo in the marketplace
Define opportunities for coaching of Sales and SEs in a technical, product or business-oriented manner.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Minimum of twelve (12) years’ experience in a technical or sales role within the telecommunications industry, with at least seven (7) years as a peer leader in technical sales engineering or Solution Engineering role.
Previous experience in a leadership role, especially a Sales or Sales/Solution Engineering leadership role preferred.
Demonstrated leadership and coaching capabilities, are a must
Expert-level technical and design skills with MAN and WAN technologies required.
Experience with Colocation and Cloud IaaS offerings a plus.
Excellent presentation skills (development and delivery) with experience in front of CIO, CTO and other stakeholders.
Ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion and confidentiality.
Ability to handle ambiguity and anticipate and quickly react to changes in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to laypersons in simple, understandable terms.
Consistent focus on results and goal achievement.

Preferred Areas of Technical Background:

Expertise in networking protocols, design and products across the OSI model
Understanding Fiber Optic network design and implementation.
Expert-level understanding of the telecom ecosystem and customer technology ecosystems

Leading end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of cyber security engagements, ensuring high quality output and client satisfaction.
Building and maintaining trusted client relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to senior stakeholders.
Developing engagement plans, budgets, and resourcing, while managing project risks and issues.
Guiding and reviewing the work of engagement teams, providing coaching and constructive feedback.

Incident Detection & Response – developing SOC strategies, incident response playbooks, and crisis management.
Data Protection & Privacy – GDPR/PDPA compliance, data governance, and privacy-enhancing technologies.
Identity & Access Management – IAM strategy, access governance, and privileged access solutions.

Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, mentor, and develop teams.

Experience in project/program management (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent).
